recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy, maximalist 1970s compilation album cover featuring a dark background layered with vibrant geometric 'trails' of repeating circles and squares, circular and rectangular photo frames, and heavy, slanted display typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Repetitive geometric shapes forming curved 'wormhole' or 'trail' effects.
High-contrast interaction between a dark navy/black ground and bright yellow, red, and cyan elements.
Dynamic diagonal flow created by slanted text and angled photo frames.
Layered hierarchy where text overlaps geometric patterns and photos overlap each other.
coreInvariants: Heavy black outlines on all primary shapes and large text.
Repeating 'echo' effect on geometric shapes to imply motion.
Diagonal shear applied to all display typography.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large display text dominates the upper third; a central cluster of circular and rectangular photo frames occupies the middle and lower sections.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bright yellow title at the top left serves as the primary entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the curved yellow circle trail from the center-left down towards the bottom, then zig-zags through the angled photo frames across the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the dark background is visible only in small gaps between dense clusters of graphics and text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep Navy/Black background providing a high-contrast foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright Yellow for primary titles and focal geometric trails.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Red and Cyan Blue for secondary geometric layers and supporting text blocks.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extremely high saturation across all primary colors against a zero-saturation black, creating a 'pop' effect.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold sans-serif with a heavy slant.
letterConstructionRules: Tight kerning with characters nearly touching.
Heavy black drop-shadow or thick outline to separate from busy backgrounds.
Italicized or sheared at approximately 15-20 degrees.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Rounded terminals on specific display fonts to match the circular geometric motifs.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, rounded display sans-serif paired with a more utilitarian, condensed gothic sans-serif for lists.
graphicDevices: Stacked rectangular frames with offset colors (red/cyan).
Circular photo masks with thick white borders.

preserve: The heavy slant of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and presence for the main title.
Matches the utilitarian feel of the tracklist and secondary info.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dark navy background. Add a curved trail of repeating yellow circles with black outlines moving from the center to the bottom left. Add stacked, offset rectangular frames in red and cyan in the corners. Include circular and diamond-shaped photo placeholders with thick white borders scattered dynamically.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, bold, yellow sans-serif title in the top left, sheared 20 degrees to the right with a thick black outline. Add secondary white and red text in condensed sans-serif fonts, some angled to match the composition's flow.

verificationChecks: Is the primary title yellow with a thick black outline?
Do the geometric shapes repeat to create a sense of motion?
Is the color palette limited to red, yellow, cyan, black, and white?
Are the photo frames angled or circular?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is horizontal if the layout demands a slant.
Check that black outlines are consistent across all elements.
Verify that the 'trail' effect looks like repeating physical objects.
Confirm the background remains dark to let colors pop.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a dark ground with a primary-color geometric 'motion' trail, then layer heavy, slanted sans-serif titles and framed photo collages to create a high-energy retro compilation look.
